definitions.explanation: Describes something that feels out of date, behind the times, or no longer in style. Carries a negative connotation — the speaker finds the thing undesirably old.
Describes a smell or atmosphere that feels stagnant or old, as if something has been sitting for too long.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦デザイン→デザイン：03860_dezain⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{古臭|ふるくさ}い。
{古臭|ふるくさ}い⟦{考|かんが}え{方|かた}→考え方：10169_kangaekata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}えた→変える：01089_kaeru⟧⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: You should change your outdated way of thinking.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ストーリー→ストーリー：11018_sutoorii⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{古臭|ふるくさ}くて、⟦あまり→あまり：00604_amari⟧⟦{楽|たの}しめなかった→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.english: The movie's story was so outdated that I couldn't really enjoy it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{古臭|ふるくさ}いにおい⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
{押|お}し{入|い}れ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}ける→開ける：00563_akeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{古臭|ふるくさ}い⟦{空気|くうき}→空気：01390_kuuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{漂|ただよ}って→漂う：04356_tadayou⟧きた。
examples.english: When I opened the closet, a stale smell drifted out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何年|なんねん}→何年：12737_nannen⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{使|つか}っていない→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{倉庫|そうこ}→倉庫：04044_souko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{古臭|ふるくさ}い⟦{匂|にお}い→匂い：00874_nioi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{染|し}みついて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: A warehouse that hasn't been used for years has a musty smell soaked into it.

notes:
USAGE:
{古臭|ふるくさ}い is an i-adjective. It always carries a negative nuance — unlike ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧, which can be neutral or even positive (e.g., for antiques), {古臭|ふるくさ}い implies the speaker finds the oldness undesirable.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {古臭|ふるくさ}い⟦{考|かんが}え→考え：00855_kangae⟧ (outdated thinking)
- {古臭|ふるくさ}い⟦デザイン→デザイン：03860_dezain⟧ (old-fashioned design)
- {古臭|ふるくさ}い⟦{匂|にお}い→匂い：00874_nioi⟧ (musty smell)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧ simply means "old" and is neutral. ⟦{時代遅|じだいおく}れ→時代遅れ：12719_jidaiokure⟧ means "behind the times" and focuses more on being out of step with the current era. {古臭|ふるくさ}い is more colloquial and visceral.
